svg.text: C4 Code: schema and vocabulary bundle

Publish and pull (ADR 0005): the authority builds and signs bundles offline and names the newest in latest.json, the issuer serves them, the connector pulls new versions, verifies them through the authority's DID, keeps them in a cache and swaps the rules without a restart
Reads bundle.json; refuses RDF/XML, paths that leave the folder and
files over the size limit; writes manifest.json and manifest.jws;
checks the result as a connector will; never writes over a version;
points latest.json at it, unless --not-latest or latest.json names
GET /bundles/{version}/{path}: the files, read only; GET
The DID document lists the public bundle key as <did>#bundle-key,
Manifest rules; compact JWS ES256 with typ portitor-bundle+jws; every SHA-256;
size limits for latest.json, the manifest, each file and the whole bundle
for a version, the manifest and
latest: the newest version. fetch: one version, verified
Takes the newest version (or the fixed one), never one issued before
the version in use; one that cannot be taken leaves the rules in use.
Each run goes to the harvest job log (kind bundle); new rules make the
DatasetHarvester check the stored datasets again
The rules in use, built with

C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. The bundle key is not the issuer's credential key; the issuer only lists its public key. latest.json is not signed: the version it names is. No context is fetched from the network.
